name: agent-workflow-reliability-dashboard
description: Japanese-first Agent Trace Triage Console prototype for AI agent workflow reliability dashboards.

scripts.build:incoming: npm run merge:incoming && node scripts/build-dashboard-data.mjs --input tmp/merged-agent-runs.json --output tmp/generated-sample-runs.json
scripts.check: npm run validate:source && npm run build:data && npm run validate && npm run validate:generated && npm run check:scheduled:example && npm run smoke && npm run safety:scan
scripts.check:incoming: npm run validate:incoming:raw && npm run build:incoming && npm run validate:incoming:merged && npm run validate:generated && npm run safety:scan:incoming && npm run safety:scan
scripts.build:scheduled:example: npm run merge:scheduled:example && node scripts/build-dashboard-data.mjs --input tmp/scheduled-example-merged-agent-runs.json --output tmp/scheduled-example-dashboard-runs.json
scripts.build:scheduled: npm run merge:scheduled && node scripts/build-dashboard-data.mjs --input tmp/scheduled-merged-agent-runs.json --output tmp/scheduled-dashboard-runs.json
scripts.check:scheduled: npm run validate:scheduled:raw && npm run build:scheduled && npm run validate:scheduled:merged && node scripts/validate-data.mjs tmp/scheduled-dashboard-runs.json --min-workflows 1 && node scripts/safety-scan.mjs --optional-target data/private-runs tmp/scheduled-merged-agent-runs.json tmp/scheduled-dashboard-runs.json
scripts.check:scheduled:example: npm run import:scheduled:example && npm run validate:scheduled:example:raw && npm run build:scheduled:example && npm run validate:scheduled:example:merged && node scripts/validate-data.mjs tmp/scheduled-example-dashboard-runs.json --min-workflows 1 && node scripts/safety-scan.mjs tmp/scheduled-example-runs tmp/scheduled-example-merged-agent-runs.json tmp/scheduled-example-dashboard-runs.json
